plate.title: B30 · Cloud valleys and round foliage
plate.description: Angular cloud companions lead the overall design. Paired round leaves and a rooted pearl occupy each existing valley in the intermediate design; fine leaves follow the actual arch courses.

constructionNotes: Angular cloud companions lead the overall design. Paired round leaves and a rooted pearl occupy each existing valley in the intermediate design; fine leaves follow the actual arch courses. Optional curved display selects only intended flowing paths and retains actual roots, tips and seam landmarks; native execution remains finite chords.
